name: Formidable Forms Google Sheet Connector
author: GSheetConnector by WesternDeal

sections.description:
GSheetConnector for Formidable Forms is an addon plugin of Formidable Forms!
A bridge between your WordPress-based Formidable Forms and Google Sheets.

✔🚀 Quick and Simple to use WordPress Plugin.
It’s an easy-to-use plugin that quickly transfers form submissions to Google Sheets. If you’re using Formidable Forms by Strategy11, you can use GSheetConnector for Formidable Forms to streamline this process. It works with both Lite and PRO versions.

The plugin helps you collect form data and store leads directly in your connected Google Sheet. Just authorize it with your Google account and grant permissions.

Features

  • Effortless Integration: Seamlessly connect Formidable Forms with Google Sheets.
  • Workflow Optimization: Automate form data transfer to Sheets.
  • User-Friendly Interface: Quick setup and configuration.

Getting Started

  1. Authentication:

    • Go to “Formidable” → “Google Sheets”.
    • Click “Sign in with Google”.
    • Grant permissions.
    • Plugin will auto-fill the auth code and activate.

  2. Connect Form with Sheet:

    • Inside your form settings, go to Settings → Actions & Notifications.
    • Click GSheetConnector.
    • Add Sheet Name, Sheet ID, Tab Name, and Tab ID.
    • Save.

  3. Add Headers in Google Sheet:

    • Use form field labels as headers in your sheet.
    • Submit the form to test data flow.
sections.installation:
Option 1: Install from WordPress Plugin Repository

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New in WordPress admin.
  2. Search for “GSheetConnector for Formidable Forms”.
  3. Click “Install Now”, then “Activate”.
  4. Navigate to the ‘Formidable’ menu → ‘Google Sheet’.

Option 2: Manual Upload

  1. Download the plugin ZIP from WordPress.org.
  2. Upload and install via WordPress admin or extract to the wp-content/plugins directory.
  3. Activate via ‘Plugins’ menu.
  4. Configure settings in the Formidable Forms integration panel.
sections.faq:

Visit our official site at https://www.gsheetconnector.com for help and support.
